reviewed_facts: loc/scale are learned Parameters; initialized is uint8 buffer; one-time no_grad statistics update.
Selected forward uses scale*(input+loc), with scalar H*W log determinant separate from data output.
QR occurs only at construction; learned W is used by conv and float64 slogdet with float32 cast.
Independent convolution and scalar log-volume outputs; no bias or spatial 3x3 kernel.
Learned w_l,w_u,w_s are distinct from P/masks/sign/I buffers; P@(L)@(U) is compound weight materialization.
Scalar determinant reads log diagonal, while conv reads reconstructed weight; neither output feeds the other.
Constant-value-1 explicit padding precedes Conv(padding=0); zero initialization still yields learned weight/bias.
Output scaling is exp(scale*3), with independent learned scale.
Conditioner reads in_a only; untouched in_a rejoins updated in_b.
Source is sigmoid(log_s+2) and (in_b+t)*s, rather than exp(log_s) or scale-then-shift.
Same retained-a conditioner boundary, source additive in_b+net_out.
Selected non-affine branch returns logdet=None, not a fabricated scalar-zero Jacobian tensor.
Source view/permute/contiguous/view is parameter-free space-to-channel; output C*4,H/2,W/2.
Permutation is (0,1,3,5,2,4); reverse PixelShuffle was not substituted.
Prior is conditioned on retained out, density evaluated on independent z_new.
Gaussian scale is log standard deviation, denominator exp(2*log_sd); kept tensor, latent and log probability are separate outputs.
Actual masked W feeds F.linear; main bias True because constructor bias argument is not passed.
Conditional Linear is independent with bias False, degree mask is buffer rather than learned attention.
Single joiner/trunk produces m,a; registered parameter paths joiner,trunk.1,trunk.3 are accurate.
Direct profile uses (inputs-m)*exp(-a); inverse is sequential coordinate iteration using same weights.
Distinct s_ and t_ parameter namespaces; source s_ Tanh predicts m, t_ ReLU predicts a.
Selected pre_exp_tanh False branch is explicit; split networks cannot be drawn as shared heads.
Biased batch variance includes epsilon, with raw input and mean as separate operands; literal determinant shape [1].
Momentum weights the old running statistics; log_gamma/beta are Parameters while running mean/var are buffers.
Fixed ordinary tensor mask conditions both separate MLPs and their complementary output masks.
Source computes x*s+t, unlike Glow shift-then-scale; init(m) is not invoked by constructor.
Sigmoid has data and summed log derivative outputs; direct/inverse branches remain explicit.
Historical Logit positional argument bug is recorded instead of silently corrected in the drawing.
Power vectors estimated under no_grad; scalar sigma still participates in weight autograd.
Training controls u/sv buffer writes, not W normalization; sv0 is logging only, new sigma is divisor.
Statistics accumulated float32 then cast back; var=E[x^2]-E[x]^2 has no clamp.
gain/bias come from caller; fused arithmetic has distinct mean,var,gain,bias inputs and no invented running-state module.
Selected caller constructor nn.Linear yields independent gain and bias parameter families, gain has +1 offset.
F.batch_norm affine=None, literal momentum .1; GN typo path and other alternate branches excluded.
theta positions 64, pooled phi/g positions16; four distinct SNConv weights, no sqrt(d) scaling.
Softmax axis -1; learned gamma initializes0; original x enters residual Add directly.
Notebook local CoralLayer overrides import; one biasless16->1 score shared across4 thresholds.
Four learned biases initialize1,.75,.5,.25; initialization does not prove maintained training order.
Actual notebook caller sigmoid(logits) followed by cumprod(dim=1); only probability decoder scope.
No invented CORN class or CORAL shared score; MLP weights excluded from the selected function boundary.
Selected Sigmoid->Reverse composition is declared constructor example rather than upstream instantiation claim.
Feature stream and accumulated logdet stream remain separate; inverse traverses same component instances in reverse order.
Source output mask degrees use hidden moduloD-1 and output moduloD minus1.
Comparison rows=output, columns=input, >= then float; get_mask returns tensor and caller alone registers buffer.
